description: Physical or operational risk. Equipment integrity, worker exposure, failure-mode indicators.
example: Crack in a hydraulic press frame. Bearing temperature. Radiation exposure. Structural fatigue.
name: safety_signal

description: Ecosystem health indicators. Biodiversity, water quality, soil status, phenology shifts.
example: Pollinator counts. Stream fish counts. Soil organic carbon.
name: ecological_signal

description: Solvency, liquidity, and risk exposure. Credit quality, off-balance-sheet items, counterparty concentration.
example: Loan portfolio default rates. Off-book derivative exposure. Counterparty concentration.
name: financial_signal

description: Physiological, epidemiological, or mental-health indicators, at the individual or population scale.
example: Infection rate. Medication side effect frequency. Population mortality shifts.
name: health_signal

description: Cohesion, trust, legitimacy. Community stress, institutional credibility, workforce sentiment.
example: Survey trust scores. Resignation rates. Complaint volumes.
name: social_signal

description: Experimental or observational results that contradict an established institutional position.
example: Replication failures. Data inconsistent with a published model. Null results on a flagship hypothesis.
name: scientific_signal

description: Planetary-boundary indicators — readings that approach or cross thresholds in the earth-systems layers of this repository.
example: Atmospheric CO2 concentration. Ocean pH. AMOC transport. Ice-sheet mass balance. Permafrost methane flux.
name: ecological_constraint_signal
